answers.core:
This presumably a somewhat common issue for all games that have voice acting in more than one language but not all languages for which text translations exist.
In addition, the complexity of a workaround or an add-on is reasonably large, while the additional functionality needed in the TranslationServer and the Editor is presumably manageable.
answers.workaround: This proposal could be worked around by implementing a custom translation server in addition to loading files from a custom file remapper as opposed to from Godot natively.

title: Allow different locales for different translation contexts
